motion_system: Keep the field still. On deliberate hover or tap, separate only the contacted existing edge slightly from its mass, revealing the source media from that boundary. Respect reduced motion.
color_drift: None at rest; retain the inspected olive-black, smoky green, pale cyan and ivory hierarchy.
glow_behavior: Diffuse haze only, without outlined glow. Interaction may clarify existing light inside the contacted opening, never add a luminous target.
